title.en: Carbon Pricing (Exemption from Section 7(1)(c) — Singapore LNG Corporation Pte. Ltd.) Order 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Carbon Pricing (Exemption from Section 7(1)(c) — Singapore LNG Corporation Pte. Ltd.) Order 2023 and comes into operation on 30 June 2023.

3.—(1) The Minister exempts SLNG from section 7(1)(c) of the Act —
(a)in relation to registering the relevant business facility as a taxable facility of SLNG for the trigger year that is 2022; and
(b)in relation to registering the relevant business facility as a taxable facility of SLNG for the trigger year that is 2023.
(2) The exemption in sub-paragraph (1)(b) is subject to the condition that the carbon dioxide equivalence of the total amount of reckonable GHG emissions from the relevant business facility in 2023 is less than 39,814 tCO2e.
